Due to his size he would do best in a home with children over 12.  Oliver is cuddly and goofy and loves everyone. He can get scared of larger dogs because he is so tiny so he would do best with smaller dogs in the home.  Oliver LOVES to be with his people ALLLL the time so he will need someone home during the day.  🐾Oliver is located in Rochester, NY.
